title: bolt1
description: A station at a fixed position on the shopfloor that realises one service. Each of its Actions runs one recipe: it produces the recipe's output product at the station's own position and consumes the recipe's inputs, whose state becomes 'consumed' and whose position becomes null. An Action has no effect unless every input product of that recipe already lies at the station. The Actions themselves differ per station and are given in the instance Thing Descriptions.

produceCaseWithCommunicationModule.title: produce caseWithCommunicationModule
produceCaseWithCommunicationModule.description: Run the caseWithCommunicationModule recipe: consume caseWithMainModule, communicationModule and place caseWithCommunicationModule at this station. Has no effect unless every input already lies at the station.

produceCaseWithMainModule.title: produce caseWithMainModule
produceCaseWithMainModule.description: Run the caseWithMainModule recipe: consume case, mainModuleWithPorts and place caseWithMainModule at this station. Has no effect unless every input already lies at the station.

produceCaseWithSensorModule.title: produce caseWithSensorModule
produceCaseWithSensorModule.description: Run the caseWithSensorModule recipe: consume caseWithCommunicationModule, sensorModule and place caseWithSensorModule at this station. Has no effect unless every input already lies at the station.
